summary: YYForce Inc., a Singapore-based BVI foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing the September 14, 2026 employment agreement appointing Andrew Davison, 47, as Chief Strategy Officer effective the same date. Base salary is SGD 156,000 (approximately US$123,000) annually, plus benefit-plan eligibility; the agreement is filed as Exhibit 10.1 and a September 9, 2026 press release as Exhibit 99.1. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or transaction mechanics are stated. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure, so no special-situation or deal terms apply.
